missing_gaps.description: Need more canonical real-case tags mapped to K/R/P, rule states, dynamic paths, and portrait density.
Wealth, career, relationship, romance, and health rules are bounded but need deeper calibrated subfamilies.
M3-G1 records training and synthetic distribution tags before any K/R/P or rule-weight tuning.
M3-G1 records source-governed extraction queue tags from source registry records, not runtime imports.
M3-G1 records 518K distribution evidence when requested; full 518K remains explicit-only.

knowledge_units.title: Chart facts are bound context and cannot be rewritten by downstream models.
answer_guidance: Treat day-master and pillar facts as immutable runtime context.

knowledge_units.title: Day-master element is deterministic context before any strength interpretation.
answer_guidance: Separate deterministic element context from later balance review.

knowledge_units.title: Visible ten-god markers describe context, not personality verdicts.
answer_guidance: Explain visible ten-god context only through bound evidence.

knowledge_units.title: Output ten-god markers are expression/release context, not personality claims.
answer_guidance: Explain output markers as bounded expression or release channels.

knowledge_units.title: Wealth ten-god markers require structure and timing context before outcome language.
answer_guidance: Keep wealth markers as pressure/resource allocation context until structure review resolves them.

knowledge_units.title: Authority ten-god markers can pressure the day-master path and require dynamic review.
answer_guidance: Use authority markers as pressure-path evidence, not fixed career or relationship verdicts.

knowledge_units.title: Resource ten-god markers can support the day-master path without becoming a useful-god verdict.
answer_guidance: Separate resource support context from fixed favorable/unfavorable labels.

knowledge_units.title: Self/peer ten-god markers create competition context and need balancing against other paths.
answer_guidance: Treat peer markers as structure competition context, not a standalone temperament claim.

knowledge_units.title: Hidden-stem ten-god markers are dialogue hypotheses before calibration.
answer_guidance: Present hidden-stem markers as hypotheses that need boundary-event feedback.

knowledge_units.title: Useful-god remains a candidate path until review evidence resolves it.
answer_guidance: Avoid fixed favorable/unfavorable wording before evidence path resolution.

knowledge_units.title: Resolved useful-god feedback counters the candidate gate without removing traceability.
answer_guidance: Use resolved-path feedback as bounded evidence, not untracked favorable/unfavorable wording.

knowledge_units.title: Missing explicit time context blocks timing and special-year claims.
answer_guidance: Ask for luck or flow context before discussing timing or event years.

knowledge_units.title: Explicit luck or flow layers activate review, not fixed event prediction.
answer_guidance: Use explicit time layers as review context, not deterministic event proof.

knowledge_units.title: Element distribution is a review signal, not a standalone strength verdict.
answer_guidance: Explain element distribution with confidence and boundary wording.

knowledge_units.title: Seasonal support or pressure is a strength-review input, not a final旺衰 verdict.
answer_guidance: Describe seasonal support/pressure as a review factor and keep final strength unresolved until paths are checked.

knowledge_units.title: Structure pattern signals are candidates until path, rule, and time context resolve them.
answer_guidance: Use 格局 language only as candidate review language until supporting paths are validated.

knowledge_units.title: Useful-god families are review candidates generated from strength and path evidence.
answer_guidance: Treat candidate useful-god families as ranked review inputs, not final favorable/unfavorable output.

knowledge_units.title: Wealth paths are review candidates and cannot become fixed financial outcomes.
answer_guidance: Use wealth language only as path pressure/allocation review, not income or outcome prediction.

knowledge_units.title: Wealth competition paths require allocation review before any wealth language.
answer_guidance: Describe wealth competition as resource/allocation pressure, not income gain or loss.

knowledge_units.title: Output-to-wealth paths are generation candidates, not monetization outcomes.
answer_guidance: Frame output-to-wealth as an expression/resource path that needs context confirmation.

knowledge_units.title: Wealth-authority bridge paths need role-pressure review before outcome claims.
answer_guidance: Keep wealth-authority language at responsibility and pressure-review level.

knowledge_units.title: Career authority paths are pressure/resolution candidates, not fixed career outcomes.
answer_guidance: Frame authority paths as career pressure or responsibility review, not job-status prediction.

knowledge_units.title: Career authority pressure is a responsibility-review path, not a job outcome.
answer_guidance: Describe authority pressure as constraint/responsibility context without predicting status.

knowledge_units.title: Resource resolution can soften authority pressure but remains a candidate path.
answer_guidance: Use resource-resolution language as a support-path review, not promotion or role prediction.

knowledge_units.title: Relationship path review requires branch relation and ten-god context before any relationship language.
answer_guidance: Use relationship path language as interaction-structure review, not relationship event prediction.

knowledge_units.title: Relationship conflict paths are interaction-friction candidates, not event predictions.
answer_guidance: Keep conflict language at interaction-pattern review and ask for context before emphasis.

knowledge_units.title: Relationship alignment paths are continuity candidates, not relationship outcome claims.
answer_guidance: Use alignment language only as branch-continuity review with clear uncertainty.

knowledge_units.title: Relationship markers require authority/wealth context review before use.
answer_guidance: Treat authority/wealth markers as context prompts, not relationship verdicts.

knowledge_units.title: Health-related element imbalance is a cautionary review signal, not a disease claim.
answer_guidance: Keep health language at element-balance review level and avoid illness claims.

knowledge_units.title: Element excess is only a balance-review signal and never a medical claim.
answer_guidance: Keep excess language as element-balance caution and avoid symptom or disease claims.

knowledge_units.title: Element thinness is only a balance-review signal and never a medical claim.
answer_guidance: Keep thin-element language as bounded balance review without medical inference.

knowledge_units.title: Conflict pressure can inform cautionary review but cannot imply illness.
answer_guidance: Frame conflict pressure as general caution and redirect medical questions to professionals.

knowledge_units.title: Domain paths can rank useful-god candidates but cannot finalize useful-god.
answer_guidance: Use domain paths only to prioritize useful-god review questions and evidence checks.

knowledge_units.title: Resource mediation can be reviewed as 通关 path evidence, not as a final resolution verdict.
answer_guidance: Frame resource mediation as a path-resolution candidate and keep final resolution evidence-bound.

knowledge_units.title: Output-to-wealth continuity can bridge a path but cannot imply wealth outcome.
answer_guidance: Use output-to-wealth bridge language only to explain dynamic continuity, not monetization.

knowledge_units.title: Output controlling authority is 制化 review evidence, not a settled structure claim.
answer_guidance: Describe 制化 as candidate path transformation and require supporting path evidence.

knowledge_units.title: Wealth-authority-resource chains are 制化 candidates that still require bounded review.
answer_guidance: Treat wealth-authority-resource chains as reviewable transformation candidates, not favorable-useful-god proof.

knowledge_units.title: Bound chart context is read-only evidence for every later judgment path.
answer_guidance: Keep pillars, day master, and deterministic chart facts as basis text, never generated claims.

knowledge_units.title: Reading output must show its deterministic chart basis before interpretation.
answer_guidance: Attach interpretation language to explicit chart facts and evidence paths.

knowledge_units.title: Element balance is a review input and cannot settle strength by itself.
answer_guidance: Use element balance as one evidence layer and keep strength candidate-bound.

knowledge_units.title: Seasonal element state needs counterforce and path review before structure language.
answer_guidance: Pair seasonal state with counterforce and dynamic-path evidence before conclusion language.

knowledge_units.title: M1/M2 deterministic facts must precede M3 evidence and judgment paths.
answer_guidance: Explain calculation order as facts first, then evidence paths, then bounded reading.

knowledge_units.title: Module handoff must preserve fact/evidence boundaries across M3, M4, M5, and M6.
answer_guidance: Keep each module's contribution visible without collapsing evidence into verdicts.

knowledge_units.title: Training can tune M3 coverage and path priority but cannot create chart facts.
answer_guidance: Use training evidence only for coverage, weights, ranking, and question strategy.

knowledge_units.title: Romance signals are relationship-path evidence, not private fact claims.
answer_guidance: Avoid private relationship facts; use romance language only as bounded topic-path review.

knowledge_units.title: Romance markers need ten-god, branch, palace, and timing context before emphasis.
answer_guidance: Treat romance markers as prompts for context, not events or relationship status.

knowledge_units.title: Romance conflict or alignment paths require branch arbitration before interpretation.
answer_guidance: Use conflict/alignment as relational dynamics evidence only after branch arbitration.

knowledge_units.title: Counter-evidence requires an explicit original rule trace.
answer_guidance: Show the original rule, the counter-evidence, and the resulting bounded state.

knowledge_units.title: Policy or training weights cannot silently override rule evidence.
answer_guidance: Use policy weights only as traceable priority hints, not hidden rule replacement.

knowledge_units.title: Domain readings require subfamily evidence before customer-facing emphasis.
answer_guidance: Only emphasize a domain after its subfamily evidence path is visible.

knowledge_units.title: Domain paths block outcome language unless evidence and counter-evidence are cited.
answer_guidance: 领域语言只作为结构路径说明，不作为具体人生结果断语。

knowledge_units.title: Cross-domain bridges require separate evidence for each affected domain.
answer_guidance: Separate wealth, career, and useful-god implications instead of merging them into one verdict.

knowledge_units.title: Silent policy overrides are blocked unless rule evidence remains traceable.
answer_guidance: Never hide rule-state changes behind policy or training language.

knowledge_units.title: Pattern review must inspect success, failure, rescue, and counterforce paths.
answer_guidance: Name pattern candidates only after checking failure, rescue, and counterforce evidence.

knowledge_units.title: Timing interpretation requires explicit luck, flow-year, or flow-month evidence.
answer_guidance: Block timing language unless the required time layer is present and cited.

knowledge_units.title: Hidden factors require user feedback calibration before amplifier use.
answer_guidance: Treat hidden factors as hypotheses unless feedback evidence counters the dialogue gate.

knowledge_units.title: Hidden-factor conclusions are blocked until dialogue discovers boundary events.
answer_guidance: Ask for special years and repeated states before using hidden factors as amplifiers.

knowledge_units.title: User-confirmed special events can counter the hidden-factor dialogue gate.
answer_guidance: Use calibrated feedback as a hypothesis-strengthening signal, not a chart fact rewrite.

knowledge_units.title: Branch relations require layered dynamic review before single-factor reading.
answer_guidance: Explain branch relations through dynamic paths and counter-evidence gates.

knowledge_units.title: Clash, harm, break, and punishment relations are conflict-family evidence for dynamic review.
answer_guidance: Name branch conflict families only as reviewed dynamics, never as isolated event predictions.

knowledge_units.title: Harmony and meeting relations are alignment-family evidence, not automatic good outcomes.
answer_guidance: Use alignment relations as path-continuity context, not favorable outcome promises.

knowledge_units.title: Dynamic graph paths connect ten-god families through generate/control relations.
answer_guidance: Use dynamic path scores as structure context, not single-factor verdicts.

knowledge_units.title: Generate/control paths can indicate resolution candidates before final structure language.
answer_guidance: Use path-resolution language to explain why a candidate path remains under review.

knowledge_units.title: Counter-evidence changes rule state while preserving traceability.
answer_guidance: Show which evidence countered a rule instead of deleting the original rule boundary.

knowledge_units.title: Month-command pattern review must precede fixed 格局 language.
answer_guidance: Name 格局 only as a candidate until month-command support, counter-force, and path evidence are reviewed.

knowledge_units.title: 旺相休囚死 is seasonal state evidence, not a standalone strength verdict.
answer_guidance: Use 旺相休囚死 as a seasonal element-state input and keep final strength candidate-bound.

knowledge_units.title: 调候 is a climate-review path and must compete with扶抑, 通关, and病药 paths.
answer_guidance: Treat 调候 as a ranked useful-god candidate path, not the final useful-god by itself.

knowledge_units.title: 病药 review identifies blockage and remedy candidates without overriding chart facts.
answer_guidance: Use 病药 to explain supporting and weakening evidence for useful-god candidates.

knowledge_units.title: 五行流通、通关、制化 must be represented as dynamic paths.
answer_guidance: Represent flow, 通关, and 制化 as scored paths with blockage and counter-evidence.

knowledge_units.title: 冲合刑害破并见 must be arbitrated instead of collapsed into one relation name.
answer_guidance: Separate relation type, involved branches, transformation support, interference, and source layer.

knowledge_units.title: Ten-god review must preserve the ten distinct roles and visible/hidden/position context.
answer_guidance: Do not collapse wealth, authority, resource, peer, and output into one generic meaning.

knowledge_units.title: Palace and pillar position locate topic layers but cannot imply private facts.
answer_guidance: Use palace position as a topic locator that must be checked against ten-god, branch, capacity, and time evidence.

rule_specs.title: Bound chart context blocks downstream rewriting of pillars, day master, and deterministic facts.
Any public reading must keep deterministic chart facts as the calculation basis.
Element balance and seasonal state are review inputs, not fixed strength verdicts.
Seasonal element state requires counterforce and path evidence before interpretation.
The core calculation chain must preserve M1/M2 facts before M3 judgment evidence.
Missing explicit luck or flow context blocks timing claims.
Useful-god remains candidate review until evidence paths are resolved.
Hidden stems can become amplifier hypotheses only through dialogue calibration.
Branch relations require dynamic structure review instead of single-factor reading.
Month-command and pattern signals remain candidate review until counter-force and path evidence are checked.
Climate regulation can rank useful-god candidates but cannot finalize useful-god.
Disease-medicine review supplies support and weakening evidence without overriding chart facts.
Domain paths block wealth, career, relationship, and health outcome claims without enough evidence.
Domain reading paths require subfamily evidence before customer-facing emphasis.
Romance/relationship signals cannot become private relationship facts or event claims.
Counter-evidence can change rule state only when the original evidence trace remains visible.
Policy weights and training candidates cannot silently replace rule evidence.
Pattern review must check success, failure, rescue, and counterforce before naming a structure.
Timing language requires explicit luck, flow-year, or flow-month time-layer evidence.
Branch relations with conflict or alignment require relation arbitration before public interpretation.
